title: A Surprise for 100k on Instagram!
transcript: There will be times when all will seem lost. You will wonder, "Where did I go wrong? How did I get myself here?" And [music] amidst the confusion, sadness, anger, and frustration, a persistent thought might creep in. A desire to just give up, stop fighting, it's no use, there's no way out. In other words, you might want to give up all hope and resign. And it will be in these moments that it will be most important to remember three words. [music] Yes, fools will resign. And as long [music] as you keep these three words in mind, there is no challenge that you cannot face. There is no position [music] that you cannot play. The game only ends when you're checkmated or when you bounce back because you didn't give up. You dared to keep going. It might also take [music] some luck, but luck only meets those who seek it. And for those who know that only fools will resign, those three words [music] will be a constant reminder that as long as they will keep playing, they will never truly [music] lose.
